title: The surface server's writer commits, rebases and pushes the planning surface (Part C of seven)
summary: Part C of seven: the surface server becomes the planning surface's one writer, chantier's Board: commits the plan within 5 min, rebases, pushes every local commit (hand ones too), retries failed git steps, raises conflicts; no writer, no write; docs, SVGs and pictures change with it. Needs A and B.
